skill.name: weibo-trend-insights
skill.description: Retrieve Weibo hot searches and keyword results through SocialDataX, then organize evidence for content planning and brand research.
skill.summary: Turn Weibo rankings and search samples into traceable trend observations.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most flags reflect Markdown syntax, service links, and expected API authentication rather than dangerous behavior. The CLI examples execute an unpinned npm package with automatic installation, creating supply-chain exposure within the credential-bearing environment. No evidence found of credential exfiltration or prompt injection in the supplied files; external package behavior was not reviewed.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md:32-38 uses npx -y socialdatax-skills@latest, executing a mutable dependency in an environment containing an API key.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and lock transitive dependencies with integrity checks; obtain installation approval and use a minimally privileged execution environment.

content.user_title: Analyze Weibo Trends with Traceable Evidence
content.value_statement: Weibo rankings and scattered search results can make content research difficult. This skill organizes SocialDataX results into trend observations with source references and clear sampling limits.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve current Weibo hot-search rankings through the documented SocialDataX CLI or available MCP tool.
Search Weibo posts using focused keywords and configurable page or item limits.
Continue searches with opaque pagination tokens and preserve partial results during recovery.
Keep hot-search rankings separate from keyword-search samples.
Retain post identifiers, links, authors, engagement metrics, and publication times when returned.
Organize observed signals and suggested content angles while separating evidence from interpretation.
limitations: Requires a configured SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance.
The CLI requires Node.js and npm; its external package implementation is not included in the supplied files.
Search has no stable completeness boundary and does not support an exhaustive all-results mode.
The documented workflow is read-only and does not provide login, posting, likes, comments, or account changes.

use_cases.title: Plan an editorial shortlist
use_cases.description: Review current hot-search signals and identify topics worth investigating before assigning content.

use_cases.title: Research brand discussion
use_cases.description: Collect bounded keyword-search samples with source references to explore discussion themes around a brand.

use_cases.title: Develop a focused content angle
use_cases.description: Compare relevant posts with hot-search signals and propose angles supported by visible examples.

prompt_templates.title: Review current hot searches
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve current Weibo hot searches. Summarize rankings and available heat signals, and keep your interpretations separate.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a keyword sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Weibo for [keyword] using one page and at most [item limit] results. Retain available post links, authors, engagement, and publication times.

prompt_templates.title: Compare evidence and content angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare current hot searches with up to [item limit] posts about [topic]. Separate both sources and propose three evidence-supported content angles.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: combine rankings and search evidence

prompt_templates.title: Resume a partial research task
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume my partial [keyword] search using its returned continuation token. Preserve earlier results, subtract completed work from original limits, and report unresolved gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover a bounded search without restarting

output_examples.input: Summarize current Weibo hot searches for editorial planning.
output: Illustrative format only; this is not live Weibo data.
Rank 1: Topic A. Heat signal: include the returned value when available.
Observation: Topic A leads the returned ranking.
Editorial angle: investigate the event behind the ranking before choosing a position.

output_examples.input: Summarize a partial keyword search and explain whether to continue.
output: Illustrative recovery summary; no live request was performed.
Evidence: retain retrieved posts with their returned source references and metrics.
Coverage: results are incomplete because the request stopped early.
Continuation: resume only with a returned nonempty token and the remaining original limits.

best_practices: Start with one page and explicit item limits, then expand only when the research question requires more evidence.
Preserve returned source references and distinguish ranking signals, search samples, and interpretations.
Review and pin the external CLI package before execution, and keep API keys out of prompts and shared reports.
anti_patterns: Treating a ranking or limited keyword sample as a complete measure of public opinion.
Restarting partial searches from the first page without accounting for earlier results and original limits.
Using this read-only workflow to request account actions or sharing API credentials in analysis output.

faq.question: What does this skill retrieve?
faq.answer: It documents retrieval of Weibo hot-search rankings and keyword-search posts through SocialDataX.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY using the provider account, and ensure sufficient service balance.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The listing supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Execution requires CLI access or the documented MCP tools.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every matching post?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable completeness boundary. Use page limits, item limits, and returned continuation tokens.

faq.question: Can it publish or modify my Weibo account?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow is read-only and excludes login, posting, likes, comments, and account changes.

faq.question: What happens when retrieval fails?
faq.answer: Preserve partial results and report the error. Resume with the returned token and remaining limits after resolving authentication, balance, or network issues.
